eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 18 · Filtering and Sorting

caption: The 10 most expensive products — TOP applies AFTER the ORDER BY.
Row order isn't guaranteed without ORDER BY — always pair the two.
10% of 504 rows = 50.4 → rounded UP to 51 rows.

code:
SELECT TOP 5 Name, ListPrice
FROM Production.Product
WHERE Color = 'Red'
ORDER BY ListPrice DESC;
caption: The 5 most expensive RED products specifically.

subtitle: What happens when the row at the cutoff is tied with another.
